statement: This sketch presents a structured visualization of the periodic table as a glowing grid where each element is displayed in its own distinct box. The entire grid exhibits a continuous ambient illumination that propagates across the elements in wave-like patterns, mimicking visible sine waves flowing smoothly through the structure. The glow effect on each element is dynamically controlled by a sine function that shifts over time, creating an energy-like motion that moves across the table from one end to the other. This visual metaphor conveys the dynamic and interconnected nature of chemical elements while maintaining clarity in presentation. The effect is purely visual, without any interaction required, demonstrating how subtle animations can bring scientific data to life.
